messages:
maria: Heads up — planning to flip the dynamic prioritizer flag in prod later today. target window 14:00–15:30 PST. safe default is OFF, will ramp to 10% canary then 50% then full if smoke passes.

alex: I can own the deploy and watch telemetry. which flag key are we using?

maria: `feature.dynamic_prioritizer.enabled` — rollout via config service (k8s configmap + console override). sample rollout doc:```yaml
- env: prod
  flag: feature.dynamic_prioritizer.enabled
  stages:
    - pct: 10
      regions: [us-west-2, eu-west-1]
    - pct: 50
    - pct: 100
  safe_default: false
```

chen: code change merged and feature gate present. integration tests green. no DB migrations. CI tag: `pr-4823`

sasha: I'll own rollback readiness. plan: if error rate > 0.5% or 99p latency regresses > 50ms for 5m, flip flag back to false and cut traffic to canary. I have the playbook link: https://go/repo/runbooks/flag-rollback

maria: smoke checklist for deploy: 1) canary at 10% 2) run 50 seqlen-64 synthetic queries (script: `tools/synthetics/prio_smoke.sh`) 3) check 99p and error rate across canary hosts 4) verify fallback route hit rate < 0.1% 5) verify no increase in token cost > 5%

alex: noted. I'll create the canary groups and trigger step 1 at 14:05. ops-bot — can you post the deployment window reminder 10m before? :alarm_clock:

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: 2026-06-02T13:55:00-07:00 for channel eng-platform.

dave: quick ask — can we add a kill-switch `feature.dynamic_prioritizer.override=false` that's easier to flip from console in an emergency? avoids editing configmap.

maria: good call. ops, can you wire that as an override?

chen: added the override key in the console controls. permissions limited to infra-admin and oncall. docs updated.

alex: preflight: I will post canary host list and synthetic run output in this thread during rollout. please ping if you want to abort. plan to promote to 50% after 20m of stable canary.

sasha: I'll be watching Grafana alerts and tracing. if I need to flip back, I'll post here + page infra-oncall and then execute flag rollback.

maria: final: safe default OFF, staged increase, kill-switch in console, rollback owner assigned (sasha), deploy owner (alex). anything else? :white_check_mark:

dave: add me to the rollout watchers for eu region.

alex: added. starting at 14:05 PST, will update status in-thread.

maria: thanks all — keeping it tight. :rocket:
